        'var': 'ar_longnames',

    },
    {
        'step': 6,
        'file': 'kar.cpp',
        'function': 'KAr::openArchive',
        'line': 93,
        'var': 'ar_header',

        'note': 'Reads a 60-byte header for the second entry from attacker-controlled input'
    },
    {
        'step': 7,
        'file': 'kar.cpp',
        'function': 'KAr::openArchive',
        'line': 108,
        'var': 'name',
        'code': 'QByteArray name = ar_header.mid(0, 16)',
        'note': 'Extracts the name field from the second header; attacker controls this value'
    },
    {
        'step': 8,
        'file': 'kar.cpp',
        'function': 'KAr::openArchive',
        'line': 124,
        'var': 'name',
        'code': 'name = &ar_longnames[name.mid(1, 15).toInt()]',
        'note': 'Uses attacker-controlled index from name field to read from ar_longnames buffer without bounds checking, causing out-of-bounds read'
    }
]

with open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(trace, f, indent=2)
print('Trace written')
"
